actions.script:
ec.message.clearErrors() recordFound = !!found?.run runInfo = found?.run || {} counts = found?.counts || {} totalsText = found?.totalsText || {} approval = found?.approval || null steps = found?.steps || {} canEdit = !!found?.canEdit canCancel = !!found?.canCancel canCalculate = !!found?.canCalculate canSubmit = !!found?.canSubmit canDecide = !!found?.canDecide // P27: why the group is not live, and whether this run may be finalized now canFinalize = !!found?.canFinalize liveReasons = Array.from(runInfo.liveReasons || []) progressPercent = found?.progressPercent || 0 employment = found?.employment || null resultRows = Array.from(employment?.results || []) takenRows = Array.from(employment?.inputs || []) unitRows = Array.from(found?.employments || []) employmentsCount = found?.employmentsCount || 0 employmentsPageIndex = found?.employmentsPageIndex || 0 employmentsPageSize = found?.employmentsPageSize || 20 employmentsPageMaxIndex = found?.employmentsPageMaxIndex || 0 employmentsPageRangeLow = found?.employmentsPageRangeLow || 0 employmentsPageRangeHigh = found?.employmentsPageRangeHigh || 0 excludedRows = unitRows.filter(row => row.state === 'excluded') const byState = runInfo.state currentStep = step || (byState === 'draft' ? 'population' : ['waiting', 'approved', 'stale'].includes(byState) ? 'approval' : byState === 'finalizing' ? 'finalize' : byState === 'finalized' ? 'settlement' : 'review') stepList = [ {key: 'population', text: '1 Population', done: !!steps.population}, {key: 'inputs', text: '2 Inputs', done: !!steps.population}, {key: 'review', text: '3 Calculate and review', done: !!steps.resolved}, {key: 'approval', text: '4 Approval', done: !!steps.approved}, {key: 'finalize', text: '5 Finalize', done: !!steps.finalized}, {key: 'settlement', text: '6 Settlement', done: false} ].map(item => Object.assign(item, {label: item.text + (item.done ? ' ✓' : '') + (item.key === currentStep ? ' (here)' : '')})) stateColors = {draft: 'grey-8', calculating: 'primary', review: 'orange-9', waiting: 'primary', approved: 'positive', returned: 'negative', stale: 'negative', closed: 'grey-8', pending: 'grey-8', calculated: 'positive', error: 'negative', excluded: 'grey-8', finalizing: 'orange-9', finalized: 'positive'} headerCaption = [runInfo.periodText, 'pay date ' + runInfo.payDateText, runInfo.kindText, runInfo.organizationName, runInfo.currencyUomId].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') reconciliation = null if (recordFound && currentStep === 'inputs') { try { reconciliation = ec.service.sync().name('mantle.humanres.PayrollInputServices.get#Reconciliation') .parameters({payrollGroupId: runInfo.payrollGroupId, timePeriodId: runInfo.timePeriodId, pageSize: 1}).call() } catch (error) { reconciliation = null } ec.message.clearErrors() } inputCounts = reconciliation?.counts || {} // P27: the settlement, Accounting's outcome of the run's obligations settlement = null if (recordFound && currentStep === 'settlement') { try { settlement = ec.service.sync().name('mantle.humanres.PayrollRunServices.get#Settlement') .parameters({payrollRunId: payrollRunId}).call() } catch (error) { settlement = null } ec.message.clearErrors() } obligationRows = Array.from(settlement?.obligations || []) settlementPeople = Array.from(settlement?.people || []) recoveryRows = Array.from(settlement?.recoveries || []) invoiceDetailUrl = sharedLinks?.['Payroll/InvoiceDetail'] || '../InvoiceDetail' finalizeConfirm = 'Finalize ' + (counts.calculated || 0) + ' employees? Their pay obligations go to Accounting, and the run is not changed again.'
hoursUrl = sharedLinks?.['Time/HoursForPay'] || null adjustmentsUrl = sharedLinks?.['Payroll/PayAdjustments'] || null runsUrl = sharedLinks?.['Payroll/PayRuns'] || '../PayRuns' // P26: the run's payslips (made when it is approved) and a correction run's original slip payslipsUrl = sharedLinks?.['Payroll/Payslips'] || '../Payslips' payslipDetailUrl = sharedLinks?.['Payroll/PayslipDetail'] || '../PayslipDetail' exchangeUrl = sharedLinks?.['Payroll/PayrollExchange'] || '../PayrollExchange' // the net is opted out of AI (P25 review): an agent's render of the confirmation names the count alone netConfirm = 'Approve ' + (counts.calculated || 0) + ' employees' + (sri.isAgentRender() ? '' : ', net ' + (totalsText.net || '')) + (counts.excluded ? ', ' + counts.excluded + ' excluded' : '') + '?'

label.text: Employees the group pays in ${runInfo.periodText} join as pending, and those it no longer pays leave. Excluded employees stay excluded. An approval no longer holds.
The group pays no employee in this period. Employees join a pay group through their pay assignment.
Approved hours, leave, pieces and payroll claims of ${runInfo.periodText} become pay inputs once; an employee with time to approve or attendance to resolve is left out and named.
A blocked employee's time waits for approval or attendance to resolve: open Hours for pay. Only approved inputs are paid; an adjustment waiting for approval is not.
Each pending, failed or changed employee is calculated on its own; one in error is named and the others go on. A long run is calculated in parts: calculate again to go on. Nothing is paid or posted.
Calculated: gross ${totalsText.gross}, deductions ${totalsText.deductions}, localization ${totalsText.localEmployee}, net ${totalsText.net}, employer cost ${totalsText.employerCost}
Period: ${employment.splitText}

Each employee's payslip becomes final and their pay obligations are made: net pay as a draft invoice from the person, the expense claims it reimburses linked as they are, the localization's amounts as one invoice from its payee. Nothing is released to Accounting until every employee is final; Accounting then approves, posts and pays.
This pay group is not live, so its runs are previews and are not finalized:
Approve the run before finalizing it.
Finalized ${runInfo.finalizedDateText}. ${runInfo.finalizeMessage}
Nothing is finalized yet: the run's obligations are made when it is finalized.
